name: ci_cd_cancel_in_progress
title: cancel-in-progress: false is mandatory for deploys
symptom: Deploy cancelled mid-way when rapid pushes occur; infrastructure left in inconsistent state (corrupt Terraform state, partially synced S3, ECS service mid-update)
cause: concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true kills the in-flight deploy when a second push arrives
fix: Always set cancel-in-progress: false in deploy workflow concurrency groups. The group is serial anyway, so there is no performance penalty.
mal_code:
concurrency:
  group: infra-dev
  cancel-in-progress: true  # KILLS in-flight deploys
good_code:
concurrency:
  group: infra-dev
  cancel-in-progress: false  # safe, serial
origin: agv-docs/IAC_TRAPS.md + AGENTS.md trap 1, validated across 15+ repos
